notes.title: Demo Patch notes - v0.1.02
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

Patch v0.1.02 aims to fix more bugs and introduces a new Item Inspector  along with several other quality-of-life improvements.

Fixed:

 Healing items now properly heal even with lower Heal/Tick values
 More typos
 Weapons stored in backpack would not load in correctly
 Weapon modification will now correctly take attachments from Inventory and try to return them to it. If it can't find free space, the item will be dropped infront of you, so keep an eye out!


Added:

 Item Inspector - To open: Click "View Details" on an Item. Each and every item can now be inspected to bring up more details about them with a 3D viewer to inspect them. Weapons will dynamically show current attachments on them. This is the first step to having dynamic Item thumbnails that represent the current state of the each weapon. 
Note: Already existing weapons in stash might not show up properly as the saving and loading of these items was changed in the backend.
 Pockets! - Players now have innate storage. This inventory will persist through death, but not its contents. 
 Health - Screen will now indicate if you have taken damage, the effects subside after 10 seconds to be minimally visible. Raising total health above 80% will remove the indicator until next hit. 
 Crafting - New Recipe: Military Backpack - 1x Metal, 2x Duct Tape
 Crafting - New Recipe: Metal - 3x Screws (So now they actually have a use)
 Gameplay - Extra Stash box in player's room next to the crafting station
 UI - More tutorial slides about Weapon Modification, Health & Healing, Ammo & Magazines
 UI - Notification for Resetting Save file
 UI - Item Tooltip now shows compatible ammo caliber for both Weapons and Magazines; also shows caliber on Ammo
 Settings - Option to Invert Mouse Vertically and Horizontally


Changed:

 Military Backpack Item Size: 3x3 -> 4x5
 Military Vest Item Size: 3x3 -> 4x4


Hope you'll enjoy!
Dávid

notes.title: Demo Patch notes - v0.1.01
notes.content:
Patch v0.1.01 aims to fix some urgent problems like crashing and some other smaller issues that could be fixed within a day. It also adds the reworked weapon customization system.

Fixed:

 Crashing when trying to modify weapon with no weapon equipped
 Settings not saving in some cases
 Enemy pathfinding into rooms
 Healing items not having an effect when trying to heal full body
 Some items spawed in the game world could not be picked up
 Multiple typos


Changed:

 UI - Tutorial UI bottom indicators and navigation buttons are now clickable
 UI - Quest Objective 'Hand In Items' button more prominent
 Gameplay - Door Interact is more lenient
 Quest - Not All That Glitters objective title change 'Duct Tape' -> 'Yellow Duct Tape'. Required item remains the same


Reworked:

 Weapon Customization UI and squashed some bugs
